description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any OwnerRez API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the host, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/v2/propertysearch?query=beach" or "/v2/bookings/123". Returns the parsed JSON.

path.description: Full API path after the host, starting with "/", e.g. "/v2/properties?limit=1".
